title: "WRAT-5 Table Extractor"
format: 
  html:
    toc: true
    theme: cosmo
server: shiny
---

```{r}
#| context: setup
#| include: false

library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(tabulapdf) # Requires Java
library(DT)

# Try to load neuro2 if available
neuro2_available <- requireNamespace("neuro2", quietly = TRUE)
if (neuro2_available) library(neuro2)

# Increase upload size for large PDFs
options(shiny.maxRequestSize = 50 * 1024^2)

# Load the lookup table globally
lookup_path <- "~/Dropbox/neuropsych_lookup_table.csv"
if (file.exists(lookup_path)) {
  lookup_table <- read.csv(lookup_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
} else {
  # Create minimal default lookup for WRAT-5
  lookup_table <- data.frame(
    test = rep("wrat5", 5),
    test_name = rep("WRAT-5", 5),
    scale = c(
      "Math Computation", 
      "Spelling", 
      "Word Reading", 
      "Sentence Comprehension", 
      "Reading Composite"
    ),
    domain = rep("Academic Skills", 5),
    subdomain = c(
      "Math", "Writing", "Reading", "Reading", "Reading"
    ),
    narrow = c(
      "Math Calculation", "Spelling", "Word Decoding", 
      "Reading Comprehension", "Reading Composite"
    ),
    pass = rep(NA_character_, 5),
    verbal = rep(NA_character_, 5),
    timed = rep(NA_character_, 5),
    test_type = rep("npsych_test", 5),
    score_type = rep("standard_score", 5),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# Define default column names for WRAT-5
wrat5_default_cols <- c(
  "scale", "raw_score", "score", "ci_95", 
  "percentile", "category", "grade_equiv", "nce", "gsv"
)
```

## Instructions

1. **Upload** a WRAT-5 PDF report
2. **Select** the page number containing the score table
3. **Map** columns from the extracted table to standard field names
4. **Download** the cleaned CSV file

---

```{r}
#| panel: sidebar
#| label: sidebar

# File Upload
fileInput("file", "Upload WRAT-5 PDF", accept = c(".pdf"))

hr()

# Page Selection
numericInput(
  "pages", 
  "Page(s) to Scan", 
  value = 2, 
  min = 1,
  max = 20
)

# Test Configuration
selectInput(
  "test_code",
  "Test Version",
  choices = c("wrat5" = "wrat5", "wrat4" = "wrat4"),
  selected = "wrat5"
)

selectInput(
  "test_name",
  "Test Name (for output)",
  choices = c("WRAT-5", "WRAT-4"),
  selected = "WRAT-5"
)

hr()

# Table Selection (if multiple tables extracted)
uiOutput("table_selector_ui")

hr()

# Download Button
downloadButton("download_csv", "Download Clean CSV", class = "btn-primary")
```

```{r}
#| panel: fill
#| label: main-content

# Status Message
verbatimTextOutput("status_message")

hr()

# Column Mapping UI
uiOutput("column_mapping_ui")

hr()

# Results Table
h4("Processed Data")
DTOutput("table_display")

hr()

# Raw Extraction Preview
h4("Raw Extraction Preview (for debugging)")
DTOutput("raw_preview")
```

```{r}
#| label: server
#| context: server

# --- HELPER FUNCTIONS ---

# Safe number parser - handles "<40", ">100", "105*", etc.
safe_parse_numeric <- function(x) {
  clean_x <- gsub("[^0-9.-]", "", as.character(x))
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(clean_x))
}

# Parse CI column (e.g., "95-105" -> stored as string)
parse_ci <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  # Standardize dash types
  x <- gsub("–|—", "-", x)
  x
}

# --- REACTIVE: Extract Tables from PDF ---
raw_tables <- reactive({
  req(input$file)
  validate(need(file.exists(input$file$datapath), "File not found"))
  
  withProgress(message = "Extracting tables...", value = 0.5, {
    tables <- tryCatch({
      tabulapdf::extract_tables(
        file = input$file$datapath,
        pages = input$pages,
        method = "stream",
        output = "matrix"
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      showNotification(
        paste("Extraction error:", e$message), 
        type = "error"
      )
      return(NULL)
    })
  })
  
  req(length(tables) > 0)
  tables
})

# --- UI: Table Selector (if multiple tables found) ---
output$table_selector_ui <- renderUI({
  req(raw_tables())
  n_tables <- length(raw_tables())
  
  if (n_tables > 1) {
    selectInput(
      "selected_table",
      paste("Select Table (", n_tables, "found)"),
      choices = seq_len(n_tables),
      selected = 1
    )
  } else {
    helpText("1 table detected")
  }
})

# --- REACTIVE: Get Selected Table ---
selected_table_idx <- reactive({
  if (!is.null(input$selected_table)) {
    as.integer(input$selected_table)
  } else {
    1
  }
})

# --- REACTIVE: Candidate Table ---
candidate_table <- reactive({
  req(raw_tables())
  
  idx <- selected_table_idx()
  mat <- raw_tables()[[idx]]
  
  df <- as.data.frame(mat, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  df[] <- lapply(df, trimws)
  
  # Auto-assign generic column names
  if (ncol(df) > 0) {
    colnames(df) <- paste0("V", seq_len(ncol(df)))
  }
  
  df
})

# --- UI: Column Mapping ---
output$column_mapping_ui <- renderUI({
  req(candidate_table())
  df <- candidate_table()
  cols <- colnames(df)
  
  # Create choices with preview
  col_choices <- setNames(
    cols,
    sapply(cols, function(x) {
      vals <- head(na.omit(df[[x]]), 3)
      preview <- paste(vals, collapse = ", ")
      if (nchar(preview) > 40) preview <- paste0(substr(preview, 1, 40), "...")
      paste0(x, " (", preview, ")")
    })
  )
  
  none_choice <- c("None" = "None")
  
  wellPanel(
    h4("Column Mapping"),
    helpText("Map extracted columns to standard field names"),
    fluidRow(
      column(4, selectInput(
        "col_scale", "Scale Name:",
        choices = col_choices, selected = cols[1]
      )),
      column(4, selectInput(
        "col_raw", "Raw Score:",
        choices = c(none_choice, col_choices),
        selected = if (length(cols) >= 2) cols[2] else "None"
      )),
      column(4, selectInput(
        "col_score", "Standard Score:",
        choices = col_choices,
        selected = if (length(cols) >= 3) cols[3] else cols[1]
      ))
    ),
    fluidRow(
      column(4, selectInput(
        "col_ci_95", "95% CI:",
        choices = c(none_choice, col_choices),
        selected = if (length(cols) >= 4) cols[4] else "None"
      )),
      column(4, selectInput(
        "col_percentile", "Percentile:",
        choices = c(none_choice, col_choices),
        selected = if (length(cols) >= 5) cols[5] else "None"
      )),
      column(4, selectInput(
        "col_category", "Category/Range:",
        choices = c(none_choice, col_choices),
        selected = if (length(cols) >= 6) cols[6] else "None"
      ))
    ),
    fluidRow(
      column(4, selectInput(
        "col_grade", "Grade Equivalent:",
        choices = c(none_choice, col_choices),
        selected = "None"
      )),
      column(4, selectInput(
        "col_gsv", "GSV:",
        choices = c(none_choice, col_choices),
        selected = "None"
      )),
      column(4, selectInput(
        "col_nce", "NCE:",
        choices = c(none_choice, col_choices),
        selected = "None"
      ))
    )
  )
})

# --- REACTIVE: Process Data ---
processed_data <- reactive({
  req(candidate_table(), input$col_scale, input$col_score)
  
  df <- candidate_table()
  
  # Build clean dataframe based on column mapping
  clean_df <- data.frame(
    scale = trimws(df[[input$col_scale]]),
    score = safe_parse_numeric(df[[input$col_score]]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Add optional columns if mapped
  if (!is.null(input$col_raw) && input$col_raw != "None") {
    clean_df$raw_score <- safe_parse_numeric(df[[input$col_raw]])
  }
  
  if (!is.null(input$col_ci_95) && input$col_ci_95 != "None") {
    clean_df$ci_95 <- parse_ci(df[[input$col_ci_95]])
  }
  
  if (!is.null(input$col_percentile) && input$col_percentile != "None") {
    clean_df$percentile <- safe_parse_numeric(df[[input$col_percentile]])
  }
  
  if (!is.null(input$col_category) && input$col_category != "None") {
    clean_df$category <- trimws(df[[input$col_category]])
  }
  
  if (!is.null(input$col_grade) && input$col_grade != "None") {
    clean_df$grade_equiv <- trimws(df[[input$col_grade]])
  }
  
  if (!is.null(input$col_gsv) && input$col_gsv != "None") {
    clean_df$gsv <- safe_parse_numeric(df[[input$col_gsv]])
  }
  
  if (!is.null(input$col_nce) && input$col_nce != "None") {
    clean_df$nce <- safe_parse_numeric(df[[input$col_nce]])
  }
  
  # Filter out rows with empty scale names or invalid scores
  clean_df <- clean_df |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(scale), scale != "", !is.na(score))
  
  # Join with lookup table for metadata
  relevant_lookup <- lookup_table |>
    dplyr::filter(test == input$test_code)
  
  if (nrow(relevant_lookup) > 0) {
    joined_df <- clean_df |>
      dplyr::left_join(
        relevant_lookup |> 
          dplyr::select(-any_of(c("raw_score", "score", "percentile", "ci_95"))),
        by = "scale"
      )
  } else {
    # Add default columns if no lookup
    joined_df <- clean_df |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        test = input$test_code,
        test_name = input$test_name,
        domain = "Academic Skills",
        subdomain = NA_character_,
        narrow = NA_character_,
        pass = NA_character_,
        verbal = NA_character_,
        timed = NA_character_,
        test_type = "npsych_test",
        score_type = "standard_score"
      )
  }
  
  # Ensure required columns exist
  final_df <- joined_df |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      test = dplyr::coalesce(test, input$test_code),
      test_name = dplyr::coalesce(test_name, input$test_name),
      range = NA_character_,
      absort = NA_character_,
      description = NA_character_,
      result = NA_character_
    )
  
  # Apply neuro2 score ranges if available
  if (neuro2_available && exists("gpluck_make_score_ranges", where = asNamespace("neuro2"))) {
    if (!"test_type" %in% names(final_df)) {
      final_df$test_type <- "npsych_test"
    }
    final_df <- final_df |>
      neuro2::gpluck_make_score_ranges(test_type = "npsych_test")
  }
  
  # Reorder columns to standard format
  final_df |>
    dplyr::select(any_of(c(
      "test", "test_name", "scale", "raw_score", "score", 
      "ci_95", "percentile", "range", "category",
      "domain", "subdomain", "narrow",
      "pass", "verbal", "timed",
      "test_type", "score_type",
      "grade_equiv", "gsv", "nce",
      "absort", "description", "result"
    )))
})

# --- OUTPUTS ---

output$status_message <- renderText({
  if (is.null(input$file)) {
    return("Upload a PDF to begin")
  }
  
  req(raw_tables())
  n_tables <- length(raw_tables())
  
  if (!is.null(processed_data())) {
    n_rows <- nrow(processed_data())
    paste0(
      "✓ Extracted ", n_tables, " table(s) | ",
      "✓ Processed ", n_rows, " valid record(s)"
    )
  } else {
    paste0("Found ", n_tables, " table(s) - configure column mapping")
  }
})

output$raw_preview <- renderDT({
  req(candidate_table())
  datatable(
    candidate_table(),
    options = list(
      scrollX = TRUE, 
      pageLength = 5,
      dom = 't'
    ),
    caption = "Raw extracted data (first table)"
  )
})

output$table_display <- renderDT({
  req(processed_data())
  datatable(
    processed_data(),
    options = list(
      scrollX = TRUE, 
      pageLength = 10,
      dom = 'Bfrtip',
      buttons = c('copy', 'csv')
    ),
    extensions = 'Buttons'
  )
})

output$download_csv <- downloadHandler(
  filename = function() {
    paste0(input$test_code, "_results_", Sys.Date(), ".csv")
  },
  content = function(file) {
    write.csv(processed_data(), file, row.names = FALSE, na = "")
  }
)
```
